force.description: Re-initialize even if configuration already exists

format.description: 'text' (default) for Markdown, 'json' for a structured response

moodle_path.description: Absolute path to the Moodle installation root directory

already_initialized.description: True when a configuration already existed and force was not set, so nothing was regenerated

config_path.description: Absolute path of the build82 configuration file

failed.description: Global index files that could not be generated

error.description: Why the file could not be generated

file.description: Path of the file that failed to generate (relative to the Moodle root for global files, to the plugin for plugin files)

generated.description: Global index files written by this call

moodle_full_version.description: Detected Moodle build number (the $version of version.php)

moodle_path.description: Absolute path of the configured Moodle root

skipped.description: Global index files served from the cache because their sources did not change

success.description: Whether build82 is initialized for the Moodle path
